update_notes: 2026-02-27: MCO-010に日本MHLW先駆け指定・オーファン指定追加、SPVN06 PRODYGY試験投与完了、NPI-001 Breakthrough Therapy指定・Phase 1/2陽性データ、OpCT-001 Orphan Drug指定追加、AGTC-501 LANDSCAPE試験・SKYLINE 36ヶ月データ追加、ZM-02 MOON試験詳細結果追加、DSP-3077新規追加

recent_updates.event: 2026 Macula Society Annual Meeting (Feb 25-28, San Diego) でpost-hoc臨床分析データを発表予定。日本MHLWから先駆け指定（Sakigake）およびオーファン医薬品指定を取得（2026年1月21日）- 網膜遺伝子治療として初。先駆けは6ヶ月審査が目標。BLA rolling submission継続中、完全提出は2026年早期予定

BLA rolling submission in progress (started July 2025). Full submission expected early 2026 with priority review eligibility. ICER (April 2025) concluded evidence demonstrates net health benefit. EMA granted Orphan designations for 5 categories of retinal dystrophies. RMAT designation for Stargardt disease
5-year safety data and 3-year efficacy data show sustained vision gains. BLA expected to be completed in early 2026 with priority review eligibility
REMAIN study: Durable 3-year vision improvements with favorable safety profile
Initiated rolling BLA submission to FDA
RESTORE trial met primary endpoint with statistical significance

MCO-010.notes: First gene-agnostic gene therapy for RP (sonpiretigene isteparvovec). Uses AAV2 vector to deliver multi-characteristic opsin (MCO) to bipolar retinal cells via intravitreal injection. Full BLA submission expected early 2026, eligible for priority review. One-time in-office injection for severe vision loss. ICER (April 2025) concluded evidence adequately demonstrates net health benefit. Also pursuing Stargardt disease indication. Japan MHLW granted Sakigake (Pioneer) and Orphan Drug designations (Jan 2026) - first retinal gene therapy to receive both, enabling accelerated 6-month review in Japan.

OCU400.status: Enrollment nearing completion, BLA submission H1 2026

recent_updates.event: Phase 3 liMeliGhT試験は予定通り進行中。BLA rolling submission H1 2026開始予定。150名（RHO 75名+gene-agnostic 75名）、カナダ50名追加。Phase 1/2の2年データで100%(9/9)改善/維持。Expanded Access Program承認済み（米国75名）

Phase 3 liMeliGhT trial enrollment nearing completion (US 15 sites ~150 patients: 75 RHO + 75 gene-agnostic, Canada up to 50 patients). Rolling BLA submission expected to start H1 2026. Top-line data expected Q4 2026. Primary endpoint completion Dec 31, 2026. EMA MAA eligible for centralized review
Phase 3 liMeliGhT trial (NCT06388200) enrollment nearing completion. Top-line data expected Q4 2026, commercialization projected for 2027
Phase 1/2 2-year data: 100% (9/9) patients improved or maintained vision
First patient dosed in Phase 3 liMeliGhT trial

OCU400.notes: Targets 100+ gene mutations. Expanded Access Program in US (75 patients) and Canada expansion (50 patients) approved. Phase 3 includes RHO arm and gene-agnostic arm with ~150 participants. BLA rolling submission targeted for H1 2026.

VP-001.status: Completed - Phase 2/3 registrational study design finalized with FDA

recent_updates.event: Phase 2/3 registrational study design finalized after FDA alignment meeting (Dec 2025). FDA confirmed sham control arm and inclusion/exclusion criteria acceptable. Phase 1/2 results (PLATYPUS 12名, WALLABY 6名): LLVA改善、微小視野改善を確認
Positive FDA meeting to finalize Phase 2/3 registrational study design
Positive Phase 1/2 results presented at ARVO: LLVA improvements, microperimetry improvements in 18 patients (PLATYPUS 12, WALLABY 6)
Received FDA Rare Pediatric Disease (RPD) designation

VP-001.notes: First therapy specifically for RP11. Positive Phase 1/2 results with vision improvements reported by patients. RPD designation makes it eligible for Priority Review Voucher (PRV) worth $100M+ if approved. FDA alignment meeting confirmed trial design for Phase 2/3.

AGTC-501.status: Enrollment completed - 12-month topline data expected H2 2026

recent_updates.event: VISTA試験登録完了（85名、12-50歳男性、XLRP確定診断）。12ヶ月トップラインデータ2026年H2予定。LANDSCAPE試験開始（2025年12月、両眼投与安全性評価）。EURETINA 2025でDAWN 9+ヶ月データとSKYLINE 36ヶ月データ発表 - 持続的な視覚機能改善を確認。laru-zova（AGTC-501）として正式名称化
Phase 2/3 VISTA trial enrollment completed (85 participants). 12-month topline data expected in H2 2026
Received FDA RMAT designation. Phase 2 SKYLINE trial 12-month data: 63% responder rate. DAWN trial: second eye treatment showed mean 16-letter improvement. $170M Series B funding completed
Phase 2 DAWN trial: 6-month interim data positive
Phase 2/3 VISTA trial initiated

AGTC-501.notes: Targets X-linked RP (laru-zova/AGTC-501). VISTA trial enrollment completed with 85 participants. Multiple positive Phase 2 trials (SKYLINE 36-month, DAWN 9+ month). LANDSCAPE trial evaluating bilateral dosing safety. RMAT, Fast Track, UK ILAP, and EU PRIME designations.

recent_updates.event: FDA Orphan Drug Designation取得（2026年1月22日）。CLARICO Phase 1/2a試験進行中。Phase 1: 用量漸増デザイン（4コホート、12-24名の法的失明患者）。Phase 2: 追加安全性・視覚機能評価（最大15名）。合計約54名登録予定
FDA Fast Track Designation granted Feb 27, 2025. First patient dosed July 8, 2025 in Phase 1/2a CLARICO trial (NCT06789445). Trial aims to enroll 54 participants to assess safety and outcomes
First patient treated in CLARICO trial - world's first iPSC-derived cell therapy tested in humans for primary photoreceptor diseases

OpCT-001.notes: iPSC-derived photoreceptor cells by BlueRock Therapeutics (Bayer subsidiary). World's first iPSC-derived cell therapy for primary photoreceptor diseases. Phase 1: dose escalation (12-24 legally blind patients across 4 cohorts). Phase 2: visual function assessment (up to 15 patients). FDA Fast Track + Orphan Drug Designation.

NPI-001.status: Positive Phase 1/2 data - Confirmatory study planned 2026

recent_updates.event: FDA Breakthrough Therapy指定取得。Phase 1/2試験（49名、2年間）で陽性データ：視覚機能喪失を約30%遅延、光受容体喪失を50%以上抑制（Usher症候群関連RP）。統計的有意性は未達だが臨床的に意味のある改善。2026年に確認的試験開始予定
Positive Phase 1/2 data: 49 patients over 2 years showed ~30% slower visual function loss and >50% reduction in photoreceptor loss vs placebo in USH-associated RP
Received FDA Fast Track designation

NPI-001.notes: Oral neuroprotective therapy (N-acetylcysteine amide/NACA). FDA Breakthrough Therapy + Fast Track + Orphan Drug designations. Phase 1/2 showed ~30% slower visual function loss in USH-associated RP. Boosts glutathione to protect retinal cells from oxidative damage. Confirmatory study planned for 2026.

recent_updates.event: 慶應大学・名古屋工大共同研究による光遺伝学治療。RV-001としてRestore Vision社が開発。AAVベクターでキメラロドプシン遺伝子を硝子体注射。低光量でも反応可能な高感度が特徴。1回投与で半永久的効果が期待。国内初の光遺伝学臨床応用
First gene therapy trial for RP in Japan initiated
First patient dosed at Keio University Hospital

Keio_Optogenetics.notes: Targets completely blind RP patients. First RP gene therapy trial in Japan. Treatment designated as RV-001 by Restore Vision Inc. (Keio University spin-off). Uses chimeric channelrhodopsin with high sensitivity enabling vision even under low light conditions. Single administration expected to provide semi-permanent effect regardless of RP genotype. Planning to enroll 6-15 severe patients with 6-month follow-up.

CTx-PDE6b.notes: Targets specific PDE6B mutations causing RP

SPVN06.status: PRODYGY trial dosing completed - Data readout expected 2027

recent_updates.event: PRODYGY Phase 1/2試験の患者投与を完了（2026年2月9日発表）。合計33名登録（SPVN06投与27名 + 対照群6名、2023年4月から投与開始）。初回データ読出しは2027年予定。2026年中に規制当局とのデータ共有を開始し、2027年にピボタル試験開始を目指す。RdCVF/RdCVFLを送達し、遺伝子変異に依存せず光受容体機能を維持

PRODYGY Phase 1/2 trial progressing well. Dose escalation (Step 1) completed Oct 2024. Controlled, randomized extension phase (Step 2) started Q4 2024. Favorable safety profile through 18 months: no SAEs, no DLTs, no discontinuations

SPVN06.notes: Gene-agnostic gene therapy for RP delivering RdCVF and RdCVFL via AAV to sustain photoreceptor function. PRODYGY trial dosing completed (33 patients: 27 treated + 6 control). Favorable safety profile through 18+ months. Data readout expected 2027, pivotal trial planned 2027. US IND approved.

recent_updates.event: LUNA Phase 2b試験進行中。2年間の二重盲検、ランダム化、シャム対照試験。81名登録予定（8歳以上）。USH2A遺伝子エクソン13変異によるRP/Usher症候群2A型が対象。西洋で約16,000人が対象変異を持つと推定。米国・英国・オランダで実施
First patient dosed in Phase 2b LUNA trial at Retina Foundation of the Southwest, Dallas

Ultevursen.notes: Targets Usher syndrome type 2A and RP with USH2A exon 13 mutations. Antisense oligonucleotide (AON) injected intravitreally to mask disease mutation in RNA. 2-year double-masked, randomized, sham-controlled trial with 81 participants ages 8+. ~16,000 affected patients estimated in Western world.

recent_updates.event: Phase 3 LUMEOS trial failed to meet primary endpoint

Botaretigene sparoparvovec.notes: Did not meet primary endpoint but showed improvements in secondary endpoints

recent_updates.event: Phase 1b試験進行中。用量漸増第2段階に進行（DSMB承認済み）。初回コホートでDLT報告なし。RPDD指定によりPRV取得可能。EMAがCTA（臨床試験申請）を承認。テュービンゲン大学（ドイツ）で実施
FDA granted Rare Pediatric Disease Designation (RPDD). DSMB unanimously approved dose escalation in ongoing Phase 1b trial
First patient dosed in Phase 1b trial

VG901.notes: Gene therapy for RP caused by CNGA1 mutations. Uses proprietary next-generation vgAAV capsid for intravitreal delivery of functional CNGA1 gene to photoreceptors. Trial conducted at University of Tübingen. RPDD makes it eligible for Priority Review Voucher if approved. EMA CTA approved for EU trial.

ZM-02.status: PRISM trial active in US and China

recent_updates.event: MOON試験（初ヒト試験）の詳細データ: 36週時点で83%の患者にBCVA ≥0.3 LogMAR改善、平均0.59 LogMAR改善。多輝度移動テストで低照度ナビゲーション能力回復。色覚回復も確認。52週時点で持続性を確認。薬物関連SAEなし、DLTなし。PRISM試験（NCT07282457）: 多施設ランダム化シャム対照用量漸増Phase 1/2、米中両国で実施
FDA cleared IND application for ZM-02, enabling multinational Phase 1/2 PRISM trial
Received FDA Orphan Drug Designation

ZM-02.notes: Gene-agnostic optogenetic therapy using AAV to deliver channelrhodopsin to retinal ganglion/bipolar cells. MOON trial (first-in-human, China): 83% BCVA improvement at 36 weeks, mean 0.59 LogMAR gain, durability at 52 weeks, no SAEs. PRISM trial now active in US and China.

jCells.status: JC02-88 trial ongoing - Interim results expected Q1 2026

recent_updates.event: JC02-88 Phase 2試験進行中。2026年Q1に中間結果予定。主要評価項目: ETDRS 15文字以上の視力改善。880万細胞の単回硝子体内注射（従来最高用量の約50%増）。最大60名（18-60歳、遺伝子型不問）。全患者UCアーバイン・ガビンハーバート眼科研究所で治療。シャム群は延長試験で治療を受ける資格あり
First patients treated in JC02-88 trial
JC02-88 Phase 2 trial officially started

jCells.notes: Cell-based therapy (famzeletcel) for RP regardless of causative gene mutation. RMAT designation granted. Previous Phase 2b showed improvements in BCVA, contrast sensitivity, and visual field. New trial tests higher dose (8.8M cells) in sham-controlled design. Primary endpoint: ≥15 ETDRS letter improvement. Interim results expected Q1 2026.

recent_updates.event: 他家iPS細胞由来網膜シート（DSP-3077）の米国Phase 1/2試験IND承認。Massachusetts Eye and Earと協力。2020年開始の神戸アイセンター病院での臨床研究では移植後2年間の生着・安全性確認済み。新鮮（非凍結）3D組織/オルガノイドを使用。2025年度中の患者移植開始を目指す

DSP-3077.notes: Allogeneic iPSC-derived retinal sheet (3D organoid) for RP. Kobe City Eye Hospital confirmed 2-year engraftment and safety in clinical research (started 2020). US Phase 1/2 at Massachusetts Eye and Ear. Uses fresh non-frozen 3D tissue. Building on pioneering Japanese iPS cell retinal sheet technology.
